content.comment_body: Import of a technical question from [user_name].

To set up the network, access the main menu of the [product_name]. When it is running, stop the process. Navigate to the Network menu and confirm with OK. Select IP Address, press OK, and then choose the desired IP address. Confirm to adjust the settings.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble establishing remote communication between their PC and a [product_name] device. They need straightforward guidance for configuring network connectivity, focusing on how to set the IP address for successful communication.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for easy, step-by-step instructions to adjust the network settings (IP address) on the [product_name] to enable remote access from their PC.
